title: Listening Drill — Optics class demonstration — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Optics class demonstration — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on optics class demonstration. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Thursday. The group will now meet on Friday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the science entrance; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is paper screen. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty-five minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check lens distance before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed ray sketch so we can offer feedback.
